Needs changes before merge.

## What looks good

- The change separates each layer cleanly: cutter validation (`camcraft-tools`), side-entry path generation (`camcraft-motion`), verification and SDF simulation (`camcraft-sim`), operation wiring (`camcraft-app`), and UI (`camcraft-ui`).
- The safety law in `crates/sim/src/verify/undercut.rs` (`Mode::Undercut`, `Warning::UndercutLift`, `Warning::ShankHit`) checks Z moves and neck clearance across sampled stations and discs. `acquit_undercut_by_prior` re-reads those findings against earlier operations.
- The solid law (`Prof::Dove`, `Prof::Ball`, `Atom::cap`) and the field simulation (`SdfTool::Dovetail`, `dove_dist`, `Stock::simulate_undercut`) model each cutter shape without clearing columns that would hide a roof.
- All four new golden files (`slot_undercut_tslot_straight.cl`, `slot_undercut_keyseat_arc.cl`, `slot_undercut_dovetail_straight.cl`, `slot_undercut_lollipop_arc.cl`) match the cutter contact point, climb/conventional order, arc centres, and single XY Z-station rule line by line.
- Two safety mutations ran locally in the review worktree and passed restoration:
  - Disabling the `UndercutLift` check at `crates/sim/src/verify/undercut.rs:120` caused `a_dive_into_uncut_stock_is_refused` and `a_retract_inside_the_undercut_is_refused` to fail (`12 passed; 2 failed`). Restoring it returned `14 passed; 0 failed`.
  - Replacing `cutter.neck_r` with `cutter.r` at `crates/sim/src/stock_sim/field_undercut.rs:37` caused `the_field_removes_the_undercut_and_keeps_the_roof` and `the_field_cuts_a_lollipop_groove_round` to fail (`12 passed; 2 failed`). Restoring it returned `14 passed; 0 failed`.

## Results merged with main

Tests ran locally in worktree `.claude/worktrees/review-2714` on head `01c44188333fd3fb2713523433297eb455415dd1` trial-merged with `upstream/main` at `163bab9b0614f56db86741cefb0cf4659fa625dc`. Commit `163bab9b0` merged cleanly; `upstream/main` later moved to `b02b344d6`, which now conflicts in `crates/app/src/operation/types/mod.rs`.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` (`tools`, `sim`, `motion`, `app`): steps 01 through 711 finished before a host restart canceled step 712 (`ui build`). Out of those 711 steps, 710 passed and 1 failed (`feature_edge_g1_join`, step 268).
- Key suites from those steps:
  - `camcraft-tools --lib`: `107 passed; 0 failed` (`undercut::tests`: `7 passed`)
  - `camcraft-sim --test undercut_laws`: `14 passed; 0 failed`
  - `camcraft-motion --lib`: `455 passed; 0 failed; 10 ignored`
  - `camcraft-app --test golden_undercut`: `4 passed; 0 failed`
  - `camcraft-app --test mcp_slot_undercut`: `5 passed; 0 failed`
  - `camcraft-app --test tool_law`: `5 passed; 0 failed`
- `camcraft-ui` quick-gate suites run directly in `.claude/worktrees/review-2714` (`--lib` and all 16 UI integration binaries: `boundary`, `boundary_picks`, `catalog_render`, `edge_loop_pick`, `feedback`, `fixtures`, `gpu_render`, `machine`, `models`, `operations`, `shell`, `sinker_setup`, `tap_hand`, `theme_example`, `theme_files`, `waterjet_tool`): every binary passed (`--lib`: `1233 passed; 0 failed; 7 ignored`; `catalog_render`: `1 passed; 1 ignored`; `gpu_render`: `11 passed; 1 ignored`; zero failures).
- `RUSTC_WRAPPER="" cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: exited with code 0 and zero warnings.

Exact failure output from step 268 (`feature_edge_g1_join`, reported as pre-existing issue #2713 on `bar_cross_holes.step`):

```text
thread 'no_pickable_edge_is_a_tangent_piece_of_a_longer_one_in_any_step_fixture' (3868332) panicked at crates/app/tests/feature_edge_g1_join.rs:94:5:
tangent pieces of one edge pick apart: [
    "bar_cross_holes.step: 116 pairs, first (20920, 20938)",
]
```

## Requested before merge

1. Add before/after UI screenshots in the PR body (`crates/ui/`). The PR modifies `crates/ui/src/egui_app/{browser_tree,icons,mod,op_icons,params_page,tool_icons,tool_settings,undercut_page}.rs` and `crates/ui/src/{interact,operations,state}.rs`. The PR body has no UI screenshots and states that no person opened the new UI page. Open the tool editor and the Slot Undercut page in the running application, upload before/after screenshots to the fork `pr-screenshots` branch, and link them in the PR body.

2. Add the dovetail angle field, undercut tool defaults, and corner-radius filter in the tool UI (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_settings.rs:96-307`, `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_cutter_params.rs:28-44`). `ToolUi` shows no `tip_angle` input field when `ToolKind::Dovetail` (`kind == 20`) is active, so a user cannot set or edit a dovetail cutter's flank angle. Switching the New tool type dropdown to `TSlot`, `Keyseat`, `Dovetail`, or `Lollipop` (`18..=21`) also skips default seeding. The default `EM-0200-2FL` draft has `diameter: 2.0`, `shank_d: 4.0`, and `tip_angle: 0.0`, which `undercut::refusal` rejects. Both views also keep `"Corner radius"` visible (`tool_settings.rs:295-307`) on undercut kinds where `corner_r` is inert. Add a `"Flank angle (deg)"` input for `ToolKind::Dovetail`, seed valid defaults when switching to kinds `18..=21`, and hide `"Corner radius"` for all four undercut kinds.

3. Keep neighbouring parts on part-source operations (`crates/app/src/operation/keep_law.rs:244-248`, `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:3235-3238, 3752-3775`, `crates/app/src/operation/kept_rejudge.rs:35-37`). `is_stock_kept_kind` includes `OpParams::SlotUndercut(_)` at `keep_law.rs:147`, whereas `is_part_kept_kind` omits it. `generate::depth_law_of` returns `DepthLaw::None` for `SlotUndercut` because `generate.rs:3235-3238` checks the source mesh through a `mode == Mode::Undercut` branch. Therefore `neighbour_parts` returns empty and `kept_rejudge` skips neighbouring parts for part-source `SlotUndercut` operations. Add `OpParams::SlotUndercut(_)` to `is_part_kept_kind` and add a test with two parts in one setup.

4. Fix `skip_serializing_if = "is_zero"` on `bulge` and `neck_slot` (`crates/app/src/project/undercut_dto.rs:15-21`, `crates/app/src/mcp/edit.rs:76-89`, `crates/app/src/mcp/job.rs:194-211`). `SlotUndercutDto` omits `bulge` and `neck_slot` from serialized JSON when they equal `0.0`. `mcp::edit::patched` rejects omitted patch keys through `lost()` (only `Value::Bool(false)` has a special case at `mcp/edit.rs:82-86`), so `edit_operation` fails with `unknown field` when a user resets `bulge` or `neck_slot` to `0.0`. `list_operation_types` also omits both fields from the `slot_undercut` schema because `seed_slot_undercut` sets them to `0.0`. Remove `skip_serializing_if = "is_zero"` from `bulge` and `neck_slot` (keep `#[serde(default)]`) and add an `edit_operation` test that resets both fields to `0.0`.

5. Support undercut moves in Simulate playback (`crates/app/src/stock_play.rs:60-67, 125-140, 199-203, 374-401`, `crates/app/src/stock_play_head.rs:110-133`). `stock_sim.rs:434` sets `Planned::moves` to empty when `Planned::undercut` is `Some(...)`. `stock_view::field_view_with` (`stock_view.rs:151-156`) cuts `p.undercut` with `Stock::simulate_undercut`, but `PlayIndex::of`, `PlayOp`, `FieldPlay::from_seed`, `FieldPlay::cut`, and `FieldPlay::set_partial` read only `p.moves`. Simulate playback then cuts zero material for a `SlotUndercut`. Handle `Planned::undercut` in `stock_play.rs` and `stock_play_head.rs` so playback removes the undercut head and neck, or refuse playback by name if deferred.

6. Resolve the merge conflict with `upstream/main` (`crates/app/src/operation/types/mod.rs`). Merge `upstream/main` (`b02b344d6`) into `issue/1444-slot-undercut` and keep both `mod tilt_basis; pub use tilt_basis::CURRENT_TILT_BASIS;` and `mod undercut; pub use undercut::SlotUndercutOp;`.

## Questions / notes

- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_settings.rs` is now 439 lines (+6 net lines over the ~400-line target). Non-blocking.
- `crates/app/src/cutting.rs:255` (`feed_mut`) does not list `OpParams::SlotUndercut`, so `cutting_rows::seed_feed_for_tool` and `retargeted_params` do not seed cutting feed from a tool's cutting-data rows when creating or retargeting a `SlotUndercut`.
- On the #1444 literature search requirement: `docs/decisions/1444-slot-undercut.md` states clearly that no web or Perplexity tool ran and lists the handbook and paper references for maintainer verification.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
